svg.metadata: {"story":"Jeremiah","act":5,"chapter":"Ch.5 · The Potter","scene":"C","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"The Lord sets the prophet by the potter's house: as clay in the potter's hand, so are you; the vessel is marred and remade.
